description: AURIN Data Portal is a data portal run by Australian Urban Research Infrastructure Network (AURIN). The portal offers curated urban data sets for Australian cities, including infrastructure, transport, housing, population and environment layers from agencies and researchers, accessed through a workbench or API. Coverage: Australia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api, csv, shp; access is free for academic and government use with an account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Browse data - AURIN") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support urban infrastructure demand and planning studies of Australian cities. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
